purpose: Define the editor workflow for importing authored scenes into the overworld map and binding them through node-logic transitions.

sceneImportWorkflow.input: worldgen scene JSON or existing project scene

sceneImportWorkflow.output: scene rectangle assignment consumed by the overworld map canvas
sceneImportWorkflow.notes: The map preview should redraw from the actual scene tilemap after every terrain/object mutation.

sceneImportWorkflow.output: world-route node with scene id, role, biome, and optional harbor/road tags

sceneImportWorkflow.input: source node, target node, source tile rectangle, target spawn
sceneImportWorkflow.output: bidirectional or one-way Transition records in the owning scenes

sceneImportWorkflow.input: scene rectangles, region nodes, and transition graph
sceneImportWorkflow.output: runtime world-map index used by client map and minimap

editorCommands.importSceneIntoWorld: Load scene JSON, assign a new ProjectSceneId if needed, and place it in the Scene Bank.
editorCommands.placeSceneOnWorldMap: Drag a scene-bank entry onto the overworld layout to create or update its rectangle assignment.
editorCommands.linkSceneNodes: Click source node then target node to create transition logic and optional travel metadata.
editorCommands.previewRuntimeMap: Render scene rectangles from current scene contents so player-built structures appear in map previews.
editorCommands.rebakeSelectedSceneTerrain: Future command: rebuild terrain visuals from semantic material layers while preserving gameplay content.

acceptanceChecks: Imported scene appears in Scene Bank with stable id.
Placed scene rectangle is visible on Overworld Layout.
Clicking a scene rectangle opens that scene in Scene Editor.
Created node link inserts matching Transition records.
Client map and minimap refresh after scene terrain or object changes.
